Every focus now has a kind and every template the kinds it fits.

Labels such as “Trace a sick child on the step back to whoever put it there” or “Use a borrowed name to get past a long wait at a shut gate”: the obstacle and the ally came from the approach’s tone pool, not the choice’s. They now come from the label’s own tone.

Three-dot ellipses (45 lines, 51 marks) beside four single-character ones, unified to “…”.
“Back from the The Pilgrims’ Road”: the wayside’s own article was kept after “the”. Ten ways back.

The Elder told every Mortal that “a mortal climbed my steps in the rain with mud to the knee”, whatever beginning they came from. The clause is gone.
A master said the Hollow Roof breath had not been seen in sixty years; the Elder, the asides and the remarks say fifty.
A letter in a dead master’s hand was carried up the stair and never said what it was for. The opened letter now says, and the Elder answers an opened one and a sealed one.
A scene heading was never given the hero’s name: “Questions for the Wanderer” was shown to a hero called Mo Lan. Headings and ending titles are now personalised.
The creation preview said “a mixed roots” and “a heaven-marked and Pill Dao”.
